title: Lowering soundness step 1: contract-faithfulness translation validation — an independent reference semantics for the spec/contract sublanguage + a Z3 equivalence check that catches ==-vs-<=-class infidelity the vacuity/mutation gates structurally cannot see

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Plan: author .design/verified/contract-tv.md — a new thermite-tv crate (deps: thermite-syntax + thermite-spec ONLY, never thermite-lower, so N-version independence is a compile constraint) with an independent reference encoder (re-implements the spec rewrites slice->@/method->spec_*/cast->nat/binop; reuses the frozen REGISTRY.verus_l3 as combinator ground truth) + a per-clause Z3 equivalence obligation (P_prod <==> P_ref). GROUNDED: faithful->verified, ==/<= + #127 byteview + combinator-predicate infidelity -> counterexample. Off-corpus generator (REQ-3) escapes the corpus bound. Honest N-version framing (evidence not proof). Scope = contract sublanguage only (body/term TV is step 2). Blockers #140-#144.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: EPIC COMPLETE (step 1 of the lowering-soundness arc). Contract-faithfulness translation validation is shipped, integrated, and critic-clean across the whole arc: the independent thermite-tv reference encoder (N-version independence compile-enforced — no thermite-lower dep), the per-clause Z3 equivalence obligation (P_production <==> P_reference), the forge tv subcommand, and the off-corpus generator. PROVEN: total corpus coverage (sum 7/7 faithful 0 skipped, binary_search 5/5, map_kv 3/3 — remaining skips are honest harder-construct gaps tracked in #150), 200-clause off-corpus generated run all faithful, subrange-bound exactness enforced, no vacuous obligations, no false positives. THE PAYOFF: the off-corpus generator immediately surfaced a REAL production lowering bug (#146 cast-< mis-parse, also hitting forge check) the five guard layers + corpus-bounded golden files structurally could not catch — the 'mechanized semantics generalized from per-program to language-level' thesis validated concretely. Fixes along the way: #145 (index-combinator arg-kind), #146/#148 (cast-< paren, both emission sites), #149 (frame slice-view consistency). Residual construct coverage (Option-match-ens, String byteview, Map/Option signatures) tracked #150. Steps 2 (term/execution semantics, kernel-gated) + 3 (translation validation against both / self-hosting) remain the broader arc.
